title: Cloud: How AI Scales Globally (The Infrastructure Behind Mistral)

# Cloud: How AI Scales Globally

## The Quick Answer

**Cloud** is using someone else's computers instead of your own.

For AI: You make API calls to Mistral's servers instead of running AI locally.

**Local:** Instant, limited scale, expensive
**Cloud:** Slight delay (1-2s), unlimited scale, cheap per-request

## Why Cloud Matters

Building AI infrastructure costs $50M+. Cloud lets you **rent instead of buy**.

- **Your own servers:** $10M upfront, then manage forever
- **Cloud API:** $0.27 per 1M tokens, no infrastructure to manage

## How Cloud Works

```
Your Request → Load Balancer → Routes to available GPU
                                      ↓
                          GPU processes request
                                      ↓
                        Response returned (1-2s)
```

**Behind the scenes:**
- Millions of requests per day (all handled automatically)
- Server crashes (automatic failover)
- Global users (regional servers reduce latency)

## Advantages of Cloud

✓ **No capital investment** (pay per use)
✓ **Automatic scaling** (handle traffic spikes instantly)
✓ **Global reach** (servers in multiple regions)
✓ **Reliability** (99.9% uptime guaranteed)
✓ **No ops team needed** (Mistral manages infrastructure)

## Disadvantages of Cloud

✗ **Ongoing costs** ($1,000+ per month for moderate usage)
✗ **Latency** (1-2s delay, not instant)
✗ **Dependency** (reliant on Mistral's infrastructure)
✗ **Data concerns** (requests go through Mistral's servers)

## When to Use Cloud vs Self-Hosting

**Use Cloud if:**
- Starting out (no $10M for infrastructure)
- Variable workload (pay only for what you use)
- Want reliability (Mistral handles failures)
- Don't have ops expertise

**Self-host if:**
- Massive scale (millions/day, amortizes infrastructure cost)
- Privacy critical (data can't leave your servers)
- Specialized requirements (need custom hardware)
- Mature product with stable demand
